description: An atmosphere only experiment with fixed Sea Surface Temperatures and Sea Ice Concentrations from pre-industrial (1850) conditions, as in piClim-control, but additionally with fixed Land Surface Temperatures (LSTs), and with quadruple the CO2 concentration (4xCO2) compared to the pre-industrial (1850) value as in piClim-4xCO2. All other forcings should be set to pre-industrial (1850) conditions. Preserving the diurnal cycle, the LSTs should be prescribed using the 3-hourly temperatures from the standard piClim-control simulation where LSTs freely evolve.
